comparison.objective: Mount a shaft between fixed and sprung bench centres, versus preassemble an ER32 collet and nut.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a lever to retract one centre, seat one shaft end, swing into line and ease the spring centre in; candidate stabilizes two loose small parts and tilt-rolls a groove past an eccentric lip.
comparison.success_condition: Both shaft centre holes must seat, lever return and hands clear without ramming/dropping; candidate requires 3-second ring retention and a light withdrawal check. Candidate pull/force thresholds are unspecified.
comparison.reason: Both use changing-axis seating under preload, but the actuated tailstock sequence and two-point shaft support test a different ability from eccentric snap capture.
